entries.condition: the time of a reading in words: in the all-matched line for each of start and end the readings hold, and in each changed reading's line, where a time not in the table reads as not recorded
the copy a changed reading is of, in its line: the mirror in its directory, a mirror where no directory is recorded, or the worker's copy

in the isolation part of the disclosure block of the run summary appendix, for a record with at least one reading: one line that every reading was the intake SHA-256 with the copies and times, or, where a reading did not match, the line that a copy did not read as it and one line per such reading, with what it read or why it was not hashed; nothing for a part without readings
basis: run_summary.disclosure.isolation.sample_integrity: expected_sha256, readings[].copy, where, at, sha256, error, seen_at

entries.condition: in the isolation part of the disclosure block, and in the sandbox status statement of a report marked with a target, when the record holds the intake digest and a target value or the invalid mark: one sentence by whether the target is another SHA-256, a value that is not one, or a value with no printable character, naming the sandbox and task where held
